entities.name: Session
constraints: contextVersion positive; rotate on login/company switch; role recheck

entities.name: Application
constraints: unique(companyId,applicationId); optimistic version; no patch after submit

entities.name: SubmissionSnapshot
constraints: immutable; unique application submission version

entities.name: FinancialStatement
constraints: eight field names; input change invalidates confirmation

entities.name: FinancialSnapshot
constraints: immutable; company/application bound; exact objectVersion sources

entities.name: InformationRequest
constraints: one OPEN per case in MVP; addressed item allowlist

entities.name: InformationDraft
constraints: CAS with requestVersion; unchanged unrequested financial fields

entities.name: Consent
constraints: no implicit delegation; expiry/revocation checked before command

entities.name: Document
constraints: only CLEAN byte versions accepted; metadata version distinct

entities.name: DocumentJob
constraints: compare generation and lease identity; retry bounded

entities.name: CommandOperation
constraints: unique(actorRef,companyId,commandType,clientKey); result retained7days

entities.name: Outbox
constraints: committed with business effect; SKIP LOCKED delivery

entities.name: Inbox
constraints: unique(consumer,eventId), atomic with handler effect

entities.name: BankCase
constraints: simulator owns decision; command result unique externalRequestId

entities.name: Offer
constraints: CAS acceptance/expiry/withdraw; full terms required

entities.name: WorkspaceProjection
constraints: full normalized stream, gap=>snapshot

entities.name: StreamEvent
constraints: persisted cursor; authorized replay and barrier

entities.name: FeatureSnapshot
constraints: immutable; source availableAt<=asOf; missing mask matches nulls

entities.name: InferenceRecord
constraints: durable before score response; idempotent same request/body

entities.name: ReleaseBundle
constraints: no runtime download; reviewer distinct from author

entities.name: KnowledgeVersion
constraints: PUBLISHED gate; revoke never undone by model rollback

entities.name: KBEpoch
constraints: increment in revoke transaction; final publication check

entities.name: AssistantMessage
constraints: authorised read; revoked source hides response; retention7days demo

entities.name: RecommendationExposure
constraints: permitted item IDs only; immutable assigned order
FEED feedback accepts only actually issuedIds; ranked-but-not-issued candidates confer no feedback permission
SAVED exposure permits feedback only for its issuedIds and does not mutate VIEW or issuedIds of a normal feed selection

entities.name: RecommendationFeedback
constraints: dedup by actor/company/clientEventId; validate event time/TTL
exact event replay has no effect; different payload under same clientEventId conflicts
FEED latest accepted HELPFUL/NOT_INTERESTED per card replaces previous reaction; client occurredAt does not override server order

entities.name: FeedPreferences
constraints: unique(subjectRef,companyId); optional/null survey answers; replace atomically invalidates active selection

entities.name: FeedSelection
constraints: opaque owner-bound cursor; atomic page reservation; stable replay minus current hidden without refill
new page reranks remaining candidates only; no VIEW on sending; foreign or stale cursor rejected

entities.name: FeedCardState
constraints: unique(subjectRef,companyId,contentId); persisted across visits
NOT_INTERESTED hides, HELPFUL saves and unhides; repeated action does not increment theme counts
confirmed VIEW requires client visibility >=50% continuously >=1000 ms; not proof of reading
userReaction is the latest HELPFUL/NOT_INTERESTED or null; only an effective transition to HELPFUL changes helpfulAcceptedSequence

entities.name: FeedSavedState
constraints: unique(subjectRef,companyId); savedVersion starts at 0 and increments transactionally on effective saved membership/order changes
saved cards include published HELPFUL regardless of VIEW or normal selection issuedIds; order by helpfulAcceptedSequence descending, contentId ascending
opaque saved cursor binds owner, catalogVersion/catalogDigest, savedVersion and immutable page/exposure; current replay is stable
saved or catalog version changes reject old cursor with 409 FEED_SAVED_EXPIRED; repeated reaction, VIEW and CLICK do not change savedVersion
